description: Microsoft Agent Framework workflow of two executors joined by one edge, with no model call, traced by the framework's telemetry.
notes: A two-executor workflow, upper then sink, as in the M4 spike (maf/t2.py). It makes no provider request, so turns is empty: the capture harness serves no turns and fails any request. The spans are workflow.build, invoke_workflow, executor.process and edge_group.process (keyed on their attributes, since they carry no gen_ai.operation.name), and message.send. Workflow ids, the builder name, the workflow definition and the edge group ids contain UUIDs that change per run and are volatile.
